description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three text annotation tools — TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT — across two categories of tweets: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” with the latter including all tweets and those containing emojis. The vertical y-axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, while the horizontal x-axis displays the two tweet categories. For “Emoji Tweets,” TEXTBLOB (white bar) achieves approximately 0.35 accuracy, VADER (hatched bar) reaches about 0.45, and ChatGPT (solid green bar) attains the highest at roughly 0.68. In the “Overall Tweet” category, TEXTBLOB drops slightly to ~0.3, VADER remains near 0.45, and ChatGPT again leads with ~0.65 accuracy. The chart visually emphasizes ChatGPT’s superior performance in both categories, with its green bars significantly taller than the others, while VADER consistently outperforms TEXTBLOB. The legend in the upper right corner identifies each tool by its bar pattern and color. The chart title, “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis,” suggests the comparison focuses on sentiment annotation effectiveness in tweets with and without emojis, supporting the paper’s exploration of ChatGPT as a tool for sentiment analysis annotation.
